newsitem.title: USA: Calif. water agencies seek supplier for 300 MW.
newsitem.headline: Calif. water agencies seek supplier for 300 MW.

text.p: The Association of California Water Agencies-Utility Service Agency has requested proposals from companies interested in supplying up to 300 megawatts (MW) of power starting in 1998.
The 70 members participating in the joint request use power to pump and treat water.
In a statement, the Sacramento-based agency said it is also looking for proposals to supply transmission and other services.
The volume of the contract is expected to grow depending on how many of the agency's 430 water district members eventually choose to join the purchasing pool.
Suppliers' proposals are due by December 18.
